name: Wasuremono
source:
Main character gets a letter with whereabouts of the Leiden Village, a lost place where he spent childhood years. Familiar rural scenery and childhood friends meet him when he arrives. And only now he can remember the secret of this place - inhabitants inherit beast features here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
